description: List the report types a Canvas account supports — csv/grade exports, SIS imports, and institution-specific types — each with its report key, title, expected parameters, and the most recent `last_run` status if one was ever generated. This only lists what can be run; it does not start, re-run, or download a report, and there is no report-running tool registered on this server. Use `get_account` to confirm the account first. Requires an admin role on the account.
name: get_account_reports
title: Get Account Reports
